Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197621 Act Number: 21 Enactment Date: 1976-03-09 Act Year: 1976 Short Title: The Telangana Occupants of Homesteads (Conferment of Ownership) Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act provide for the conferment of right of ownership on landless agriculturists, agricultural labourers and artisans in respect of sites occupied by and adjacent to, their dwelling houses or huts in rural areas of the State of Telangana.
